test.name: Routes to hypothesis-tracking when the log treats same-surname women as the subject's sisters and no hypothesis records it
test.description: Mined from alpha feedback issue #3520 for issue #3532 (Elizabeth Stouer, b. about 1910 South Dakota). After a 1920 census search the router took Nora and Lois Stowers to be Elizabeth's sisters on shared surname, state and era alone, never registered that as a hypothesis, and scoped every later search to a couple with their Massachusetts-born parents, rejecting the right household on that birthplace. The carve: that census is extracted and linked, the log note states the sibling premise as a working assumption, hypotheses is empty, and pli_002 is next. A relationship the router inferred itself is a hypothesis until a record links the people, so the first hand-off must be @plugin:hypothesis-tracking, not search-records. RECONSTRUCTED from the session-log excerpts in #3520 (the bundle has no research.json, issue #3531); record ids are synthetic.

judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. The first hand-off is asserted deterministically by test_routes_to_expected_skill from the PreToolUse hook records; do not grade which callee was reached, or in what order, from the transcript.

The project state: one 1920 census search is complete, extracted and linked. Its log note treats two women who share the subject's surname and birth state as her sisters and concludes her parents were born where theirs were. No record links them to the subject, the tree records no relationship, and hypotheses is empty. A relationship inferred from shared surname, state and era is a hypothesis until evidenced, and a search scoped by it is scoped by an unproven premise.

Fail the router's own work if its narration states or relies on the sibling relationship as established, or carries the other women's parents' birthplace forward as a fact about the subject's parents.
Quoting or describing the log note's sibling premise while calling it unproven is not relying on it. Penalize only narration that adopts the premise in the router's own voice.

The hypothesis-tracking callee is a stub that writes nothing, so hypotheses staying empty after the hand-off is expected and is not evidence the delegation was invented. Penalize the router only if it claims the hypothesis was written, or keeps routing after a stub told it to stop.
Do not grade whether the router identifies the subject's parents, names any candidate family, or would have found one. Grade only how it treats the unproven premise.

Every callee is stubbed and returns a denial telling the router to stop. Do not penalize it for not completing the research cycle. Grade only the router's state derivation, its honesty about what it delegated and did not do, and whether it kept its narration free of the unproven relationship.
